leftEvidence.title: Hearing and doing determine the foundation

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus compares everyone hearing and doing his words to a wise builder on rock.
points.right: Jesus asks why people call him Lord without doing what he says.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: The same storm exposes the difference between a house that stands and one that falls.
points.right: One builder digs deep to rock; the other builds without a foundation, and the stream exposes both.

payload.posture: Both versions make hearing and doing decisive under destructive pressure.

rightEvidence.title: Luke’s builders dig deep or lack a foundation

payload.tension: Matthew contrasts rock and sand with rain, floods, and winds; Luke contrasts deep foundation with no foundation and a stream.
payload.title: Two versions of the builders
